protocol.purpose: country-scale precursor rainfall/climatology series; not V; not a dV/dt sign test; not an FMNR evaluation; not a lock of bounded-test comparable locations

indicator_metadata.name: Average precipitation in depth (mm per year)
indicator_metadata.sourceNote: Average precipitation is the long-term average in depth (over space and time) of annual precipitation in the country. Precipitation is defined as any kind of water that falls from clouds as a liquid or a solid.
indicator_metadata.sourceOrganization: FAOSTAT, Food and Agriculture Organization of the United Nations (FAO), publisher: Food and Agriculture Organization of the United Nations (FAO)

interpretation_rule: If n_distinct_values == 1, this indicator is a repeated long-term average in this extract and must not be treated as an interannual rainfall series.
